  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"Only R08 holds, making Linkage the sole adverse family. The shared home address has three accounts, but its recent registration prevents the household exception. No earlier outcome settles the order. Row §6.6(b) therefore applies, and its required id_check has passed; no contact check is required. Under §5.3(a), clear is mandatory and further adverse dispositions are prohibited. A genuine household is the strongest benign explanation. Verification establishes identity and card possession, not repayment intent; no installment was due. No further check is needed."
